definition: `C.InOrdinaryUse m`: the move m belongs to the ordinary practitioners' use: it is taught to them in catechesis or professed by them, as the creed is.
note: Stipulated (#1010). Both ordinary-use evidence premises are supported, not stated: knowability by the Catechism (CCC 31-38, official English translation) and confession by the pinned creed and the Catechism (CCC 185-189, 199-200). Whether catechesis addressed chiefly to bishops and catechists (CCC 12, read but not pinned) counts as ordinary use is not settled by any pinned record.
